newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lakes Oil to farm-in to Otway PEL39.
newsitem.headline: Lakes Oil to farm-in to Otway PEL39.

text.p: Energy explorer Lakes Oil NL said on Monday it had reached agreement with Cultus Petroleum NL to earn a 10 percent interest in the onshore South Australia Otway Basin permit PEL39 by contributing to the cost of the East Avenue-1 well.
The East Avenue-1 well is scheduled for drilling in the last quarter of this year.

Lakes Oil said East Avenue was potentially a very large trap with an estimated size of the Pretty Hill Sandstone target at up to 440 billion cubic feet (BCF) of gas in place with a most likely value of about 79 BCF gas in place.
